# Kyoto Cultural & Culinary Itinerary

This 3-day plan is optimized for two adults, focusing on the historical Higashiyama and Arashiyama districts while staying near Kyoto Station for maximum transit efficiency.

## Recommended Neighborhood: Shimogyo-ku (Near Kyoto Station)
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/13/Kyoto_Station_building_2015.jpg/1200px-Kyoto_Station_building_2015.jpg Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
Staying near **Kyoto Station** provides immediate access to all JR lines, the Karasuma Subway, and the city's central bus hub. This location minimizes transit time to all major districts and offers abundant evening dining options.

## 3-Day Daily Schedule

Day 1: Historic Higashiyama & Gion
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/3/3a/Kiyomizu-dera_Kyoto_Japan.jpg/1200px-Kiyomizu-dera_Kyoto_Japan.jpg Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- **Morning**: Kiyomizu-dera Temple. Explore the iconic wooden stage and hillside views. Travel: Bus 206 from Kyoto Station.
- **Afternoon**: Sannenzaka & Tea Ceremony. Traditional walk followed by an authentic tea experience in a Gion machiya.
- **Evening**: Gion District. Evening walk through Hanami-koji for traditional architecture and geiko sightings.

Day 2: Arashiyama Nature & Zen
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/b/b5/Arashiyama_Bamboo_Grove_Kyoto.jpg/1200px-Arashiyama_Bamboo_Grove_Kyoto.jpg Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- **Morning**: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove & Tenryu-ji. Walk the bamboo paths and world-class Zen garden. Travel: JR Sagano Line.
- **Afternoon**: Adashino Nenbutsu-ji. A quieter, atmospheric temple further up the hill. Travel: Walking or local bus.
- **Evening**: Togetsukyo Bridge. Sunset views over the Katsura River.

Day 3: Market Flavors & Shrines
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/22/Nishiki_Market_Kyoto_Japan.jpg/1200px-Nishiki_Market_Kyoto_Japan.jpg Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
- **Morning**: Fushimi Inari Shrine. Hike through the thousands of vermilion torii gates. Travel: JR Nara Line.
- **Afternoon**: Nishiki Market. Explore 'Kyoto's Kitchen' for street food like octopus balls and pickled vegetables.
- **Evening**: Pontocho Alley. Final riverside dinner at a narrow, traditional alleyway.

## Budget & Transit Summary

Category | Estimated Cost (USD) | Notes
Food | $360 | $60/person/day avg
Activities | $150 | Entry fees + Tea Ceremony
Transport | $60 | Subway/Bus passes
Total | $570 | Within $600 budget
